title: pvWriteJPEGWriter
body:
## pvWriteJPEGWriter

Explicit-export writer that saves image data (vtkImageData) as a JPEG (.jpg) file: 1 to 3 components of unsigned char values, compressed lossily at VTK's quality 95. Publication uses the pixels contract, comparing dimensions, components and values after re-reading, so a positive export tolerance is required (zero is rejected at planning) and pvWritePNGWriter is the choice for exact pixels.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A tolerance of 0 is rejected at planning (INVALID_TOLERANCE) because JPEG compression changes values; choose a tolerance in the 0 to 255 value range or export PNG. Verification also requires the pixels comparison.
- VTK's writer accepts only unsigned char (8-bit) scalars (vtkJPEGWriter.cxx:219-223); other scalar types, or an image without active scalars, fail before writing with UNSUPPORTED_DATA_TYPE. Convert upstream, because Schemaxis performs no implicit conversion.
- Schemaxis manages the file name, so export 2-D images; a numbered 3-D stack needs a file pattern.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with a pixel tolerance of 3 and the other options at their defaults; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `JPEGWriter`. Identity: `writers/JPEGWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "pixels",
  "extensions": [
    "jpg"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteJPEGWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ]
}
```
